methods.gap: Actual wins minus (48*games/162 + fWAR). Keep original values, all 150 team-seasons and negative gaps.
methods.ordering: Sort original gaps, breaking ties by season and MLB team ID; one point per team-season, without bins.
methods.reference: Normal quantiles mu+sigma*Phi^-1(p_i); mu and sigma (population SD, ddof=0) estimated from these gaps. Reference line y=x; no regression refit.
methods.interpretation: Descriptive distribution shape only; fitted location and scale do not validate WAR, causality, random luck or future predictions. Shapiro results are exploratory because independence and a common distribution are not established.
methods.distinction: The plotted normal is fitted to the actual gaps; this is not the previous independent-game binomial model.
